description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved drawings and documents) and 7 (district heat and power system) to allow the installation of Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHPs) and associated works at Puffin House, 80 Carlton Vale, London, NW6 5GX of Deemed (Reg4 Councils Other Development) reference 14/1896 dated 23 September, 2014, for Demolition of 209 existing dwellings and garages at Gloucester House and Durham Court and erection of 4-8 storey blocks comprising of 236 flats (134 private and 102 affordable (social rent)), an energy centre for the South Kilburn Neighbourhood Decentralised Heating System, basement car-park, associated landscaping and general amenity space, provision of replacement public play space and stopping up of existing  public footpath between Cambridge Road and Kilburn Park Road.
site_name: Former Durham Court and Garages, Kilburn Park Road, London, NW6  & Gloucester House and Garages, Cambridge Road, London, NW6
